title: Product Security Engineer
description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase .
 As an Offensive Security Engineer on the Application Security team within Security, you'll pioneer how Coinbase uses frontier AI models to scale vulnerability discovery, red team AI systems, and automate security workflows. This role bridges traditional penetration testing with next-generation AI-augmented offensive security, directly accelerating our ability to protect products and customers. You'll own the development of AI-driven security tooling and collaborate across Vulnerability Management, Offensive Security, and Incident Response to fundamentally shift how we operate.
 What you'll do:
 Build, deploy, and maintain custom security scanners that leverage frontier models to detect vulnerabilities at scale across Coinbase's product surface.
 Lead red teaming efforts against internal AI systems, including jailbreak testing, prompt injection analysis, and tool abuse simulation.
 Develop AI-driven automation for vulnerability triage, validation, and remediation workflows to accelerate the bug bounty and vulnerability response pipelines.
 Partner with engineering teams to prioritize, remediate, and verify fixes for critical vulnerabilities discovered through AI-augmented and manual testing.
 Mentor junior security engineers on integrating AI into offensive security workflows to scale team capabilities.

title: Senior Stock Administrator
location: San Francisco Bay Area or Remote (U.S.)
description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.
 Discord is where hundreds of millions of people come together around games, communities, and shared interests. Behind the scenes, our Stock Administration team makes sure every equity award — from a new hire's first grant to a multi-year vesting RSU release — is handled accurately, compliantly, and with care.
 We're looking for an experienced Senior Stock Plan Administrator to join our team supporting the day-to-day administration of Discord's global equity programs, including equity grants, option exercises, RSU releases, and special projects. On any given day, you might be supporting the administration of equity grants, walking an employee through their vesting schedule, or partnering with our auditors to test a SOX control. You will partner with key stakeholders in our Finance, Payroll, Tax, Legal, and HR teams to answer employee inquiries, educate employees on equity programs, improve processes, implement controls, and provide reporting as needed. You will also work directly with external auditors and third-party vendors. This position will report directly to the Senior Manager, Stock Administration.
 What you'll be doing:
 Manage the daily administration of Discord's global equity plans — from participant eligibility and enrollment through award processing, exercises, settlements, tax withholding, mobility reporting, expirations, cancellations, repurchases, and terminations.
 Process, validate, and reconcile equity transactions across equity administration platforms, payroll, and the general ledger, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and timely resolution of discrepancies.

title: Operations Associate
description:
Data & Infrastructure Associate Role Description
 The Data & Infrastructure Contractor supports analytics, reporting, KPI tracking, and data infrastructure initiatives across Pay Operations, Contractor Growth, CR & Training, and Robotics teams. This role combines hands-on data analysis with the development and maintenance of reporting tools, dashboards, and structured datasets that enable operational visibility and informed decision-making. The position works closely with Contractor Leads to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and timely reporting.
 Responsibilities
 1. Pay Analytics Support (Contractor Ops)
 Provide reliable and structured data support to the Pay team.
 Maintain and improve pay-related datasets to ensure accuracy and consistency.
 Build and maintain recurring reports and dashboards to support contractor pay tracking.
 Assist in identifying discrepancies and supporting audit processes.
 2. CR & Training Data Support
 Support the definition and tracking of core KPIs for CR and Training contractor teams.
 Build and maintain recurring performance reports.
 Ensure KPI definitions are documented and consistently applied.
 Assist teams with ad-hoc data requests and analysis.
 3. Growth Analytics Support (Contractor Ops)
 Maintain and optimize queries used for candidate sourcing and prioritization.
 Support analysis to improve candidate throughput and quality.
 Assist in tracking performance metrics related to growth initiatives.
 Contribute to experimentation analysis and reporting.
 4. Robotics & Workforce KPI Tracking
 Support the implementation and tracking of operational KPIs.
 Maintain reporting structures to monitor workforce performance.
 Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure consistent measurement practices.

description:

 Additionally, you will actively engage with security professionals on cross-department initiatives, participating in projects aimed at fortifying the company's overall security posture.
 This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

title: Accounting Manager, Tokenized Equities
description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase .
 Coinbase Tokenized Equities give eligible non-US users a simple way to buy tokens backed 1:1 by US stocks and ETFs — no brokerage account needed. The tokens are issued out of Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), a regulated financial center overseen by the FSRA, and trade 24/7 onchain. We're hiring an Accounting Manager to be the finance lead for this product. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who likes to build. You'll own the accounting and reporting model from the ground up — accounting policy, regulatory and legal entity reporting, controls, GL operations, and finance systems — coordinating across Tax, Treasury, FP&A, and controllership, as well as external auditors and regulators. If you like solving hard problems and building from scratch, this role is for you.

 Build the accounting model from the ground up — covering token issuance and redemption, asset tracking, intercompany flows, and the close process
 Own regulatory compliance and reporting to the FSRA for this business. This includes liaising with the regulator to ensure a consistent understand of the rules, building a robust, efficient and well controlled reporting process and remaining responsive ad hoc queries
